glyphs.reading_codepoints: The grid label is the HTML character reference ' (U+0027 APOSTROPHE) in K'IN.
glyphs.gloss: day; sun; calendar unit k’in, 1st (lowest) position in the LC = 1 day
glyphs.gloss_note: The entry page writes the vowel in k’in with U+2019 RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK.
